test_title: PYST 61: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 15th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: 4 men and 4 women can complete a work in 5 days, while 2 men and 5 women can finish it in 6 days. How much time (in days) will be taken by 1 woman working alone and 1 man working all by himself to complete the work, respectively?
solution:
**Given:**

4 men and 4 women completed it in 5 days

2 men and 5 women completed it in 6 days

**Calculation:**

(4 Men + 4 Women) × 5 = (2 Men + 5 Women) × 6

⇒ 20 Men + 20 Women = 12 Men + 30 Women

⇒ 8 Men = 10 Women

⇒ Men : Women = 5 : 4

Total Work = (4 Men + 4 Women) × 5

⇒ Total Work = (4 × 5 + 4 × 4) × 5

⇒ Total Work = (20 + 16) × 5

⇒ Total Work = 180 units

Time required for one woman to complete work

⇒ 180/4 = 45 days

Time required for one man to complete work

⇒ 180/5 = 36 days

**∴ One woman and one man can complete the work in 45 days and 36 days respectively.**
